csv_project_name: AE Svc for T5010 Huli Circle - YNHA
csv_scope_of_work: The Yakama Nation Housing Authority ("YNHA") is requesting proposals from qualified individuals or firms for Architectural Design Services to include architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, civil, and landscape design. This includes site plans, specifications, and construction administration and inspection services. The individual or firm must be licensed to do business in the state of Washington. The project consists of five duplexes, and three single-family homes to be located in the T5010 Huli Circle Addition, Wapato WA 98951, with the nearest access point located at Fort Road and Huli Circle.
